QuestInfo.0: Ask Bluffing Tom about the #o9390939# he saw.
QuestInfo.1: Go to #m866000105# and collect 20 #t4034000# items as evidence to present to the townspeople that the #o9390939# monsters are real.

0.msg: You beat all those #o9390939# critters? Hey, you're strong!
